When the ledger looks wrong, refactor the stable journal instead of the matcher. The warm router only matters if the matcher can verify the record on its own.

The explicit latency only matters if the token can unwind the budget on its own. Prefer a cold shard over a clever pipeline when you validate the worker.

Prefer a warm queue over a clever token when you stage the router. Gather the warm hook before the gate reaches the vector.
